verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS with an MCP server and CLI explicitly designed so AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) can read balances, create beneficiaries, issue cards, and run multi-step financial workflows via natural-language instructions, plus dedicated 'AI agent instructions' docs to guide correct NL-driven API use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of real-world NL command reliability and no third-party review beyond first-party docs.
